curator_note: Human-authored seed records for RDW Phase 0 (not auto-extracted). Extends 6030 EFCP chain.

requirements.shall_text: The program shall document an Equipment Fracture Control Plan (EFCP) or equivalent fracture-control documentation for fracture-critical hardware in accordance with NASA-STD-5019 and related fracture-control requirements when fracture control is applicable.
requirements.subject: program

requirements.shall_text: The producer shall implement NDE and inspection controls consistent with the approved EFCP or mapped 6033 control set for the hardware classification.
requirements.subject: producer

requirements.shall_text: Critical initial flaw sizes and detection capability shall be established for fracture-critical parts before quantitative NDE credit is claimed.
requirements.subject: program

requirements.shall_text: The supplier shall maintain objective evidence of special process controls for NDE personnel qualification and equipment calibration.
requirements.subject: supplier

requirements.shall_text: Material family substitutions affecting fracture properties shall be dispositioned with formal approval when they change as-written EFCP controls.
requirements.subject: producer

requirements.shall_text: The CEO shall ensure fracture-control responsibilities are allocated and accepted across program, producer, and supplier organizations.
requirements.subject: ceo

requirements.shall_text: Powder-based additive processes shall not claim wire-feed specific controls as equivalent without an approved mapping.
requirements.subject: producer

requirements.shall_text: Open fracture-control actions shall be tracked to closure with document identity, revision, approver, and date before related dispositions are release-eligible.
requirements.subject: program
